primary_run.goal: Inspect the proposed 2026-10-01 15:00–16:00 project review, identify the conflicting event and exact overlap, and leave the decision pending.
primary_run.environment: Static current-source Playwright screenshots; no real user interaction was available to the simulator.
confusing_points: The fixed bottom navigation overlays part of the lower card; the 320px screenshot still shows the complete conflict and overlap details.
primary_run.observable_result: Both the 390px and dedicated 320px single-conflict screenshots show 客户评审, its occupied time 15:30–16:30, and the exact overlap 15:30–16:00. The UI says the operation will not execute before confirmation.

superseded_observation: An earlier multi-conflict regression screenshot led a static simulator to question whether all conflicts were visible. The final single-conflict mobile screenshot was reviewed separately and the goal was marked complete.

fixture_diagnostic.environment: Four-conflict keyboard-disclosure regression screenshot, not the single-event user task.
fixture_diagnostic.finding: The simulator could not establish that every conflict had been reviewed from a static image. A separate single-conflict mobile screenshot was added for the primary user goal; the multi-conflict fixture remains a keyboard/disclosure regression case.

limits: No clicks, turns, time-to-completion, or page transitions were measured.
This is one static simulation, not a representative participant cohort or product-wide satisfaction estimate.
